denominator_definitions.draw_weighted_flips: Each of the 73 sampled slots per draw contributes once; repeated source participants count repeatedly. Compare reconstructed label with that participant's original full-sample label.
denominator_definitions.unique_inbag_flips: Each distinct source participant appearing in a draw contributes once; absent participants are not classified. Pooled rate divides summed participant-draw flips by summed distinct participant-draw appearances.
denominator_definitions.participant_flips: For each participant, flips divided by the number of draws in which that participant appears at least once. Repeated copies must have identical labels.

interpretation: Label changes and distribution displacement are descriptive properties of the existing bootstrap. They do not isolate a causal contribution of relabeling from sample composition or establish superiority of one interval method.
